name: mound_thrash
desc: A low flat puddle of thick pink paint goo heaves violently from below, the surface bulges up in two or three lumps at once and splatters thick sticky globs that fall back in, then it slumps flat. Only goo: no hands, no faces, no objects. Low and flat, wide and sloppy, sticky, wet, glossy, pink marble with yellow streaks. Something is trapped and struggling underneath.
